_comment: Blocks an Age's rock or sea may not be made of, though their shape says they could -- see `Materials`.
The shape rule asks whether a block is a whole cube you cannot fall through, and cannot ask whether it
Leaves decay wherever no log stands near, and frosted ice melts on its own, so a world of either would
evaporate shortly after it was written.
This wins over `valid_for_terrain` where a block is somehow in both, because a refusal is the safe
way to read an authoring mistake.
